# Character Architect - Krea 2

Character Architect is a character-generation workflow built around the **CharacterPromptFactory** node and **Krea 2 Turbo**.

It provides a wide range of selectable or randomized character attributes, including gender, ethnicity, facial features, physical traits, body type, hairstyle, clothing, cosplay, accessories, poses, composition, environments, colors, textures, and visual styles.

---

## Model Links - Local Users

This workflow is configured for the **Krea 2 Turbo INT8 ConvRot** model.
For the official BF16, FP8, INT8 ConvRot, MXFP8, and NVFP4 variants, see:
[Comfy-Org Krea 2 models](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Krea-2)

[Download krea2_turbo_int8_convrot](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Krea-2/blob/main/diffusion_models/krea2_turbo_int8_convrot.safetensors)

[Download the Qwen3-VL text encoder](https://huggingface.co/alienmafio/my-krea2-loras/blob/main/qwen3VL4BAbliteratedComfyui_v10.safetensors)

```text
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── 📂 KREA 2/
│   │       └── krea2_turbo_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   │

│   │

│   │

```

The subfolders are optional.

If you use different filenames or folder locations, update the corresponding model selections inside the workflow.
